caveats.iem_sparsity: IEM ASOS 1-min data for KNYC Aug 2026 has 900 observations (~50min avg gap), limiting intraday resolution. METAR data used instead for denser coverage.
caveats.nwp_fetch_timing: GFS forecasts may be fetched at varying lead times; closest fetch_date < target_date used.
caveats.nwp_overlap: Overlap with KXHIGHNY settlements: 125 dates (GFS), 115 dates (ECMWF).
caveats.metar_daily_stats_quality: daily_stats table had data quality issues (gross outliers filtered).
caveats.intraday_model_simplification: Simple trajectory models used. No AI/ML in loop per policy.

strategy_a_h24.description: Use GFS temperature_2m_max forecast from ~24h before target date

strategy_a_h24_ecmwf.description: Use GFS temperature_2m_max forecast from ~24h before target date

strategy_b_h6.description: Use METAR observations at ~h-6 (18:00 UTC) + trajectory to predict daily high

max_observed_to_18utc.description: Use maximum temperature observed up to 18:00 UTC

max_lagged.description: Use max up to 18UTC, or temp at 18UTC + 3h lagged rate
